description.value: The Spot is a tech-forward boutique hotel in Nanaimo offering keyless smart locks, contactless mobile check-in, and minimalist modern rooms with rainfall showers and in-room mini-fridges. Located on Terminal Avenue North, it sits within easy reach of the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists crossing between Vancouver Island and the mainland. Free parking is available for all guests and a 24/7 virtual concierge provides around-the-clock support.

address.value: 950 Terminal Ave N, Nanaimo, BC V9S 4K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Spot is an active boutique hotel at 950 Terminal Ave N, Nanaimo, with free parking, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi confirmed both by OSM (internet_access=wlan) and multiple website passages, and USB charging ports at in-room work desks. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; both required criteria must be marked null. OSM tags the property as 'tourism=motel' while the website consistently brands it a boutique hotel.
